summary: Earnings analysis for Salesforce Inc. is constructive but execution-sensitive. The latest actual period shows revenue growth and earnings resilience, while the forecast depends on continued margin expansion, cost discipline, and demand durability. The key debate is whether Salesforce Inc. can sustain EPS growth and justify its valuation premium through product-cycle execution, recurring revenue growth, and operating leverage.
key_points: Salesforce Inc. generated $41.5B of revenue in 2026A; latest observed revenue growth was 9.6%, providing the starting point for the earnings forecast.
Year-over-year revenue growth was 9.6%, indicating a strong acceleration in top-line momentum.

EPS increased to $7.85 in 2026A and is forecast to reach $9.36 by 2027E; the implied earnings upside depends on sustaining revenue growth while converting margin expansion into per-share profit growth.
EBITDA is forecast to increase from $13.2B in 2026A to $19.4B in 2027E; this makes operating leverage and margin execution the central earnings debate.

EBITDA margin is projected to expand from 31.7% in 2026A to 40.4% in 2027E; the magnitude of this step-up should be treated as an important execution assumption rather than a mechanical extrapolation.
Contribution margin is expected to rise from 77.7% to 80.7%, supporting the earnings growth outlook through pricing discipline, services mix, and cost control.
SG&A margin is expected to move from 41.8% to 40.3%, indicating continued cost discipline.
